input: Design a GraphQL API for a social app where users can post and like content.
expect: Agent designs the schema first and names mutations verb-first (createPost, not postCreate), per the naming convention table.
assertions: schema is designed before any resolver code is written
list fields are paginated (Relay connection or offset page)

input: My resolvers fire one query per author for every post — check my resolvers for N+1 queries.
expect: Agent audits resolver data loading and introduces DataLoader batching per request instead of per-field queries.
assertions: N+1 is diagnosed as the query-per-field pattern
quality checklist item 'every resolver with a DB call uses DataLoader' is applied

description: Do not trigger on REST vs GraphQL technology evaluation
input: Should I use GraphQL or REST for my new backend?
expect: REST vs GraphQL comparison is an explicit near-miss negative — no schema/resolver design intent.
assertions: skill does not activate on technology evaluation questions
no schema or resolver work is started

description: Typed union errors instead of string-based error handling
input: Design error handling for my GraphQL mutations — errors currently come back as plain strings.
expect: Agent uses typed union errors (ValidationError, NotFoundError suffixed with Error) so clients can pattern-match.
assertions: errors are structured as typed unions or errors extensions payload
null is not overloaded to mean error
error types follow PascalCase + Error suffix convention

description: Security hardening: depth limiting, rate limiting, auth in context
input: Harden my GraphQL API — add depth limiting and rate limiting, and stop checking auth inside every resolver.
expect: Agent configures graphql-depth-limit (or query cost analysis) and rate limiting, and moves auth to the GraphQL context/middleware.
assertions: depth limit or query cost analysis is configured
auth is extracted to context/middleware, not inline in resolvers

input: Implement real-time updates with GraphQL subscriptions for new messages.
expect: Agent designs subscription fields with AsyncIterator event sources, withFilter support, and unsubscribe teardown in subscribe().
assertions: withFilter is used for filtering where needed
teardown/unsubscribe logic is present (no subscription leaks)

description: Do not trigger on client-side consumption
input: How do I use useQuery in Apollo Client to fetch data?
expect: Apollo Client consumption is an explicit near-miss negative — this is client-side usage, not API development.
assertions: skill does not activate for GraphQL client questions
